s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic, severe, mechanical low back pain and mental depression with cutaneous and subcutaneous lesions and muscle contractures
salient_findings: Large and deep, irregularly shaped, cutaneous ulcer on the right forearm
Woody induration of skin on forearms and abdominal region
Bilateral contracture of deltoid, triceps, and biceps muscles
key_facts: 7-year history of severe, mechanical, low back pain
Current medications include duloxetine hydrochloride, clonazepam, oxcarbazepine, fentanyl, sulpiride, zopiclone, omeprazole magnesium, and baclofen
Self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, 100 mg 4 times per day, for the past 3 years
Cutaneous ulcer on the dorsum of right forearm with necrotic tissue and muscle exposure
Histopathology shows lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates

differentials: Subcutaneous fat necrosis of the newborn
Panniculitis associated with systemic lupus erythematosus
per_call: Subcutaneous fat necrosis of the newborn
Panniculitis associated with systemic lupus erythematosus

shortlist.label: Factitial panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine and presence of cutaneous ulcers and panniculitis

shortlist.label: Meperidine-induced fibrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's long history of meperidine injections and presence of fibrosis in deep dermis and subcutaneous septa

shortlist.label: Lipodermatosclerosis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of woody induration of skin on both forearms and abdominal region, consistent with lipodermatosclerosis

shortlist.label: Panniculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Histopathology shows lobular panniculitis, subcutaneous fat lobules with necrotic adipocytes and dense inflammatory infiltrates

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic fasciitis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of bilateral contracture of deltoid, triceps, and biceps muscles, and elevated serum creatinine kinase

raw.rationale: The patient's history of self-administering subcutaneous injections of meperidine, the presence of cutaneous ulcers, and the histopathology showing lobular panniculitis with necrotic adipocytes and inflammatory infiltrates support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Meperidine-induced fibrosis
rejected.why: While meperidine use is a factor, the histopathology and clinical presentation are more consistent with factitial panniculitis

rejected.label: Lipodermatosclerosis
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with a different set of clinical and histopathological features, such as post-phlebitic syndrome

rejected.label: Panniculitis
rejected.why: This is a broader category, and factitial panniculitis is a more specific diagnosis that better explains the patient's presentation

rejected.label: Eosinophilic fasciitis
rejected.why: The lack of eosinophilia and the presence of lobular panniculitis make this diagnosis less likely

gold: Fibrosis and ulceration caused by meperidine
